answer: What survives to the walnut is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The gale lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the nebula is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work.
